scope: Real packets on isolated Linux veth links; no physical wire or external service test
checks: DHCP address, DNS answer, ICMP and application baseline

Offer/ACK address, gateway and DNS options
TCP handshake flags in one stream

Two normal runs and two failure cleanup paths
Host links/routes/forwarding/resolver and service process inventory unchanged
